Elena (BetaApps): Hey folks, hitting a hard block. Our app calls /v1/chat/completions with a function schema and the runtime rejects the assistant's function_call with a JSON schema error. Error text: \"schema validation failed: required\u003e\u003e 'email' missing; additionalProperties not allowed: 'debugMeta'\". This started after we pushed a quick prompt update.
Maya (Support): Thanks Elena. Can you paste the outgoing request (functions block + call) and the raw assistant response that contains function_call.arguments? Also which SDK & model?
Elena (BetaApps): SDK 1.5.0, model 'rw-chat-3b'. Outbound request:
```json
{"model":"rw-chat-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Lookup account 9001"}],"functions":[{"name":"lookupAccount","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"accountId":{"type":"integer"},"email":{"type":"string"}},"required":["accountId","email"],"additionalProperties":false}}],"function_call":{"name":"lookupAccount"}}
```
Assistant returned (excerpt):
```json
{"choices":[{"message":{"role":"assistant","function_call":{"name":"lookupAccount","arguments":"{\"accountId\":9001,\"debugMeta\":{\"trace\":true}}"}}]}
```
API error to client: 
```json
{"error":{"message":"JSON schema validation failed: required: email; additionalProperties: debugMeta","type":"invalid_request_error"}}
```
Devon (Eng): TL;DR: two failures: missing required field 'email' and an extra property debugMeta. The runtime validates parsed arguments against the function parameter schema (ajv). The assistant often omits optional or customer-supplied fields; here email is marked required by the customer schema but the model didn't supply it.
Maya (Support): Did you author the schema manually in the dashboard? If yes, you can remove 'email' from required or set additionalProperties: true as a short-term fix.
Elena (BetaApps): We did define the schema in the console. We thought email could be optional — must've been copied wrong. But users still see random extra keys like debugMeta injected by the assistant context. Expectation: runtime should ignore unknown keys, not fail hard.
Priya (SRE): From infra logs for request id 9c2f: validate_arguments() raised ValidationError. No container OOMs or infra faults. Validation step is synchronous in the request path which is why this surfaces as an immediate API error.
Riley (QA): Repro steps I used: 1) POST the request body above to /v1/chat/completions. 2) Mock assistant returning arguments string with accountId only + debugMeta. 3) Redwood runtime calls JSON.parse on arguments, runs ajv.validate(schema, parsedArgs) -> false. Error provides diffs.
Devon (Eng): Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) Expand error message to include which properties are missing and which extraneous keys were present (we already include but we will standardize). 2) Add per-tenant \"lenient_function_validation\" flag to ignore additionalProperties and to not require missing required fields if a fallback mapping exists. 3) Implement a sanitizer middleware (opt-in) that: a) parses the arguments string, b) strips keys not listed in schema.properties if additionalProperties=false, c) tries type coercion for obvious cases (\"123\" -> integer) when safe.
Kala (PM): Need to define UX: default strict or permissive? Customer expectations differ. We should provide an explicit opt-in toggle and docs with examples.
Maya (Support): Elena, would you like us to opt BetaApps into the sanitizer canary while we finalize policy? It's reversible.
Elena (BetaApps): Yes please. Our integration is blocked in production. Opt us in and let us test.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary build 2026.03.16-08 applied to tenant BetaApps.
Priya (SRE): Canary logs show sanitizer engaged for tenant BetaApps. Telemetry: sanitizer.strip_extra=1, sanitizer.coerce=0 for first 200 requests. No measurable latency increase (+3ms p95).
Devon (Eng): Note on coercion: we'll only coerce when schema expects integer/number and the assistant returns a numeric string; we will log any coercion and surface it in debug output. We'll not coerce complex types.
Riley (QA): Confirmed behavior: assistant returned accountId as string "9001" and debugMeta object. With sanitizer on, the runtime strips debugMeta and coerces "9001" -> 9001, then call proceeds to customer's function backend. We added unit tests for nested additionalProperties too.
Maya (Support): Ticket T-20260316-01 created and linked to this thread. Elena, please validate in your staging and paste any failing payloads here.
Elena (BetaApps): Tested staging. One odd case: assistant returned email as null explicitly. Schema requires string. After sanitizer, it left email missing (since null isn't a string) and call still failed. Can sanitizer coerce null->empty string or drop keys with null?
Devon (Eng): We won't silently coerce null->string by default. Options: a) drop null keys where schema expects string (configurable), b) coerce null->\"\" (not recommended). We'll add a per-tenant toggle 'treat_null_as_missing' and document caveats.
Priya (SRE): Canary extended 2 hours while we monitor. No errors introduced.
Kala (PM): Action items: 1) Docs update with examples showing required vs optional and additionalProperties usage. 2) Add UI toggle and clear label: \"Lenient function argument validation (may coerce types and discard unknown keys)\". 3) Decide default policy in next roadmap meeting.
Maya (Support): Marking ticket T-20260316-01: canary opt-in active. Closing ticket pending Elena confirmation. :white_check_mark:
Elena (BetaApps): Working in staging now. Thanks for fast help. We'll confirm by EOD.
Devon (Eng): Internal: PR #2041 implements sanitizer + toggles + logs. QA tests cover: required missing, additionalProperties present, numeric-string coercion, nested extra props, null handling flag.

Priya (SRE): Postmortem placeholder created in incidents channel referencing this thread: INC-20260316-12. We'll include telemetry and customer impact.
Maya (Support): If Elena confirms all green, we'll mark the ticket resolved and include recommended schema snippets in the response.
Elena (BetaApps): Confirmed - staging OK. Thanks all. Will request a support note for production flip later today.
